description: Trump wins Iowa caucuses with 51% of vote.
Trump sweeps Super Tuesday primaries; Haley suspends campaign on March 6.
Jury finds Trump guilty on all 34 felony counts in Manhattan.
CNN Presidential Debate between Biden and Trump in Atlanta.
Trump injured in shooting at campaign rally in Butler, PA.
RNC convenes in Milwaukee; Vance announced as VP.
Biden announces withdrawal from presidential race and endorses Harris.
DNC convenes in Chicago; Harris accepts presidential nomination.
ABC News debate between Harris and Trump in Philadelphia.
Four anonymous accounts (Fredi9999, Theo4, PrincessCaro, Michie) begin massive Trump bet accumulation ($30M+).
2024 United States Presidential Election polls close.
